work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: To the Reader

items.text: Do not hold a fellow countryman as a servant beyond six years.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, To the Reader
items.quote: Prohibiting the Children of Jocob, to make one of their Nation a Servant more than Six.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Give them food that is wholesome and enough, for the laborer is worthy of it.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Masters, give unto your Servants, that which is just and equal.

items.text: When they are sick, show compassion and do not leave them or withhold justice.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: My Master left me, because Three Dayes agone, I fell sick.

items.text: Clothe them neatly, warmly, and modestly, with garments for winter and Lord's Day as well as for weekdays.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: She is not afraid of the snow, for her Houshold; for all her Houshold are Clothed With Double Garments.

items.text: Pay the wages you have contracted to give them, at his day, and do not oppress an hired servant.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: At his Day thou shalt give him his Hire, neither shall the Sun go down upon it

items.text: Do not indulge sloth or thievery; restrain them from drunkenness, wantonness, gaming, and bad company.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: A Servant will not be Corrected by words; for though he understand, he will not Answer.

items.text: When you must punish, moderate stripes with humanity so that the servant is not killed or maimed.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Eye for Eye, Tooth for Tooth, and Life for Life, will be demanded

items.text: Reward faithful servants with encouragement, liberty, and preferment, and let them know they are dear to you.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: The Centurions Servants was dear unto him.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: Title Page

items.text: Take the methods that should be taken to obtain a good servant for the household.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served, Title Page
items.quote: the Methods that should be taken by the HEADS of a Family, to Obtain such a SERVANT

items.text: Be a good servant: possess the necessary properties and practice the necessary practices in every kind of servitude.
items.citation: Mather, A Good Master Well Served, Title Page
items.quote: Necessary Properties & Practices Of a good SERVANT In every kind of Servitude

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Serve your master and mistress in the family so that the Lord Jesus Christ is glorified through your service.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Let your Service unto the Matters [and Mistresses] of the Families, where you are Servants, be such, that the Lord Jesus Christ may thereby be Glorified.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Obey your masters as unto Christ, not with eye-service, but with good will doing service as to the Lord.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Servants, Be obedient unto your Masters, as unto Christ; Not with Eye service, but as the Servants of Christ; with good will, doing service as unto the Lord.

items.text: Do not run away from your master or mistress; stay and submit yourself to them.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Return to thy Mistress, and submit thy self unto her Hands... Stay with thy Master, & submit thy self unto him

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Be diligent in your master's service: avoid sloth and idleness, whether your master is good or hard.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, IV
items.quote: Let your Diligence in the Service of our Masters (and Mistresses) be such as to render you Profitable and Acceptable Servants.

items.text: Go and come nimbly on your master's errands; do not loiter or be a sluggard.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, IV
items.quote: Let Servants go and come nimbly, and be upon the Wing in the Errands of their Masters

items.text: Do not do your own business or profit by your labor without your master's allowance.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, IV
items.quote: Though it must be still with the Allowance of their Masters, if they would honestly Do for Themselves.

items.text: Be faithful in all your master's interests: do not purloin but show all good fidelity.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, V
items.quote: Not purloining, but showing all Good Fidelity.

items.text: Do not steal from your master even the smallest amount; take nothing, give nothing, without leave.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, V
items.quote: Never Give to Others, Never Take to your selves, of your Masters Goods, without their Leave, unto the Value of a Farthing.

items.text: Do not betray your master's secrets or injure the household where you lodge.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, V
items.quote: beware of Betraying the Secrets of your Masters, or injuring the Nests where you lodge

items.text: If you have wronged your master, make restitution if able; otherwise make penitent confession.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, V
items.quote: You must, if you are able, make some Restitution... but, if you are not Able to do That, you must however make a most Penitent Confession

items.text: Do not let a servant's lie go unpunished; punish it more severely than any other fault.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, V
items.quote: let that Fault Never, I say, Never go Unpunished.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Revere him with awe; the more of God is in him, the more fear to displease him.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: If your Masters are those that have the Fear of God in them, You then have not the Less, but the more cause to Fear Them, with your most Awful Regards.

items.text: Do not despise him because he is a brother; serve him rather, because he is faithful and beloved.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: They that have Believing Masters, let them not Despise them, because they are Brethren; but rather do them Service, because they are Faithful and Beloved

items.text: Overlook his failings and be loath to see his follies, as Shem and Japheth covered their father's nakedness.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Overlook their Failings; and be as loath to see their Follies, as Japhet and Shem were to see their Fathers Nakedness.

items.text: Be subject to him with all fear, not only if he is good and gentle, but also if he is froward.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Servants be subject unto your Masters, with all Fear; not only to the Good and Gentle, but also to the Froward

items.text: Think and speak reverently of him; do not reproach or slander him, but preserve his honor abroad and do not carry tales.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Think Reverently of your Masters, and Speak Reverently of your Masters; Don't Reproach your Masters... Preserve the Honour of your Masters Abroad

items.text: Imitate him in all his laudable properties and practices.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: You are to Imitate your Masters in all their Laudable Properties and Practices

items.text: Avoid sullenness, sauciness, and impudence; answer modestly when expected, and do not talk back or insist on your own way.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: all Sullenness, all Sauciness, all Impudence, in your Deportments towards your Masters (or Mistresses) is to be abominated

items.text: Obey his commands as his instrument, promptly and thoroughly, not only when his eye is upon you.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Servants, your Tongues, your Hands, your Feet, are your Masters, and they should move according to the Will of your Masters.

items.text: Do not break his just commands, for resisting his power resists the ordinance of God.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: The just Commands of your Masters, cannot be broken but at the same instant you break the Command of the most High God, whose Kingdom Ruleth over all.

items.text: If he commands anything contrary to the fear of God, refuse to obey; obey God rather than man.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: If your Masters put you upon the doing of any thing, that is contrary to the Fear of God, then, in the Fear of God, forbear to Obey; rather Suffer than Obey.

items.text: If he bids you read, hear, and live by the Word of God, obey him conscientiously.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: If your Masters bid you to Read, and Hear the Word of the Lord, and Live according to the Word, and give them some account of your proficiency by that Word; Obey them Conscientiously.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Do all lawful service for your master or mistress as service to the Lord Jesus Christ, heartily and not with eye-service.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Whatsoever Service you do for your Masters (or Mistresses) do it as a Service unto the Lord Jesus Christ.

items.text: Yield to your master and mistress the reverence due from a servant; treat them with respectful demeanor as an ordinance of God.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Yield unto your Masters (and Mistresses) that Reverence, which is due from a Servant unto a Master.

items.text: Be humble in your station; do not be discontented with lowness or clothing, but wear humility as a badge of service.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Servants, be Humble; if you would not fall into the Condemnations of the Devil!

items.text: Do not let private religious meetings cause you to neglect your master's business, become slothful or saucy, or keep unseasonable hours; if you do, you are hypocrites.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: That since you have gone to Private Meetings, you grow more slothful, and more sawcy, and that their Business is more neglected

items.text: Observe your masters with a fear of disobliging them, and comply with their commands as an ordinance of God.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, A Good Master well Served
items.quote: You ought alwayes to Observe your Masters, with a Fear of Disobliging them

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Do not despise the cause of your manservant or maidservant; treat them justly and consider their complaints.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: I despise not the cause of my manservant, or my maidservant.

items.text: Instruct your servants in the way of God, that they may not be ignorant of any saving truth.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Let your Servants be able to say of you, as in Math. 22. 16. Master, thou teachest the way of God, in Truth.

items.text: Inquire prudently into your servants' spiritual estate: their experiences, temptations, and behavior.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: enquire critically into their Spiritual Estate before God. Be prudently Inquisitive into their Experiences, into their Temptations, into their Behaviours.

items.text: Reprove every miscarriage you discern in your servants; show them the paths of the destroyer and lovingly, solemnly, scripturally chide them out of those paths.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Show them all the Paths of the Destroyer, and Lovingly, Solemnly, Scripturally Chide them out of those Paths.

items.text: Require your servants to do what pleases God: charge them to repent of sin, believe on Christ, consider their ways, prepare for eternity, and not omit daily devotions.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Charge them to Repent of Sin, Believe on Christ, and Consider their Wayes, and Prepare for their Eternity, and not Omit the Daily Devotions of a New-Creature.

items.text: Especially charge your menservants and maidservants to remember the Sabbath day, to sanctify it.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Especially, the Commandment Charges you, to Charge your Man servants, and your Maid servants, That they Remember the Sabbath Day, to Sanctifie it.

items.text: Pray for your servants and with them continually, as the prophet prayed for his servant and the centurion prayed for his.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Pray for them, You, Pray with them, continually.

items.text: As mistress, do the same for the souls of your servants as masters are charged.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Mistresses, Consider also, what is to be your part, in the doing thereof.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Be serviceable to your master really, thoroughly, and universally, doing all friendly offices in his many interests.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: Let it be your Study to be Serviceable unto your Masters (and Mistresses) Really, Thoroughly, Universally Serviceable.

items.text: Strive to be a blessing to the whole family where you live.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: Lord, make me a Blessing to all the Family where I Live!

items.text: Teach your master's children and pray for them continually, that they may fare well spiritually.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: if you will be continually Teaching of them, and Praying for them?

items.text: Watchfully take pains with and for your fellow servants to bring them to God.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: if you do watchfully take Pains with them and for them?

items.text: If your master has a vice, speak or write to him with humility, warning him of the danger and seeking his spiritual recovery.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: What knowest thou, O Servant, but thou mayst Save thy Master?

items.text: Carry your master in your prayers daily, asking the Lord's blessing upon him.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VI
items.quote: carry thy Master in the Arms of thy Prayers unto the Lord, for His Blessing; Do this every Day

items.text: Abandon all bad courses and mispending of time; divide your time justly between your master and your own soul, and redeem time for knowledge and goodness.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VII
items.quote: Divide your Time justly between your Masters, and your Own Souls

items.text: Do not read romances; they corrupt the mind and waste precious time that should be used for God and your generation.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served, VII
items.quote: The Reading of 〈◊〉 Romances... Distemper not your Souls, with such Venemous Papers

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Obey your master in all things, as unto Christ.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Servants obey in all things your masters according to the flesh

items.text: Count your master worthy of all honor.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: count their own Masters worthy of all honour

items.text: Do not answer back to your master.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: no answering again

items.text: Do not steal from your master.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Not purloyning

items.text: Show all good fidelity in your service.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: shewing all good fidelity

items.text: Serve not with eye-service, but in singleness of heart, as unto Christ.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Not with eye service, as men pleasers, but as the Servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart

items.text: Do service with good will, as to the Lord, and not to men.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: With good-will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men

items.text: Be subject to your master with all fear, even if he is harsh.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: Servants be subject to your masters with all fear, not only to the good & gentle, but also to the froward

items.text: Do not despise a believing master because he is a brother, but serve him all the more.
items.citation: A Good Master well Served
items.quote: let them not despise them, because they are brethren: but rather do them Service

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Shun evil company and its corrupting habits, lest you become useless to your master.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Your Masters are never like to have any Good of you more, if you are once fallen into the Snares of this Evil Company.

items.text: Do your master good and not hurt all the days of your service, and behave virtuously until your time is expired.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: to Do his Master Good and not Hurt, all the Dayes, of his being so Related.

items.text: Have a motherly regard for the children you tend, caring for them as if they were your own.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: have such a Motherly Regard for the Children which are perhaps to be Tended by you

items.text: Do all the service you can for your masters and mistresses, and be orderly in everything; do not steal, lie, run away, or commit fornication.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Do for your Masters, and your Mistresses, all the Service that you can; and be orderly in every thing.
items.conflict: Chattel slavery is contrary to Scripture's teaching on human dignity and equality in Christ; this passage wrongly justifies it.

items.text: Use your servants as those who have reasonable souls, treating them according to the law of charity.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: the Law of Charity requires your Owners to Use you, as those that have Reasonable Souls within you.

items.text: Repeat to your servants the words of God and the gospel, so that they may become servants of the Lord.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served
items.quote: Masters, These poor Negroes will hardly mind what I say; I pray, do you Repeat it unto them.

work: A Good Master Well Served. A Brief Discourse on the Necessary Properties & Pract
heading: A Good Master well Served

items.text: Give them work to do and see that it is well done; do not allow them idleness.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: The first Thing that you owe to your Servants, is, Work. Let them have Work to do, and let their Work be well done; countenance them not in any Idleness

items.text: Do not command them to do any sinful or evil work.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: Lay no Sinful Commands upon them, nor appoint them any Evil Work.

items.text: Do not overwork them or lay cruel, hard tasks; be merciful and consider their strength.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: Lay no Cruel Commands upon their not appoint them Too Hard Work.

items.text: Teach them the trade or mystery of your calling, and do not conceal it from them.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: If Servants are with you, to Learn, any Mystery in your Occupation, t'will be a most Complicated, Cousenage and Robbery in you, to Conceal that Mystery from them.

items.text: Do not teach them any subtle or shuffling tricks that belong to the arts of cheating.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: Show them not any Subtile and Shuffling Tricks, which belong to the Arts of Cheating.

items.text: Give them good: food, wages, and kind provision as their due.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: Three Things to be due from a Master, unto a Servant; namely, Work, and Good, and Discipline

items.text: Discipline them as a father, for their good, not as a tyrant.
items.citation: A Good Master Well Served, III
items.quote: Masters indeed should be Fathers unto their Servants.
